notes.title: Small Patch 5/14/2023 Save System Fixes
notes.content:
Hi BountyHeart players,
I just pushed a small patch today to address some bugs with the save system that have popped up, as well as some other small bugfixes / usability improvements. 

1. Save system now properly loads the save when you are in the 2nd map. 
2. Boss Upgrades should no longer lock you upon selection if you are at the maximum number of party members / board size. 
3. Divine Organ 3 star is fixed.
4. If you have excess gold, the excess gold pop-up will automatically select the shop if you are currently selecting character / enemy details. 
5. Mush Mother and Gobius, the Frogun upgrades now work as intended. 
6. Difficulty 1 and above now correctly grant an extra Boss Upgrade at the beginning of the Run.

I apologize for the bugs, as some of them had slipped past my testing due to a disparity between the Steam Build and my in engine Unity build. I'll continue to test to minimize the bugs. As always let me know if you have feedback or find any bugs in the Steam community thread or in discord!

notes.title: 🐸 Quality of Life Patch 🐸 5-13-2023
notes.content:
Hi, here’s a small patch that should address a lot of the feedback regarding accessibility and resolutions. Here’s a quick rundown of the changes:
1. Frame rate cap - the cap is now set to 60 FPS. 
2. Quit - you can now Quit the application from the Pause Menu and from the Title screen.
3. Volume settings in the Pause Menu will now be saved between sessions.
4. Full screen - game now starts in full screen and this can be toggled off to windowed mode in the Pause menu. 
5. Confirm - can now also be done via the Space Bar and via a Confirm Button right above the Cancel Button besides Double Clicking. 
7. X button UI icon should now be clearer.

I also wanted to apologize regarding missing these features on launch, and I really appreciate all the feedback so far, it has been very helpful! I'll be continuing to improve BountyHeart going forward, and I appreciate all your time and support.

notes.title: 🐸 BOUNTYHEART DEMO QOL UPDATE 🐸
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day! Here's a small QoL patch to fix some UI issues and bugs that should hopefully make the demo experience more smooth until the official release of the game in May! 

Rough Patch Notes:
[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Hovering over a stat now shows the base stat and the modifications to that stat by items / abilities.
- Stats that are modified by items / abilities now have a color indicator and UI icon to show they have been modified. 
- You can now see your current active team and items in the shop.
- New items / characters will have an indicator showing they are new until you interact with them.
- UI scaling issues fixed in Party Loadout screen
- The Victory screen now displays how much Gold was earned from that encounter.
- Map nodes are now correctly labeled after leaving an encounter.
- Misc bug fixes

Thanks for checking out the demo and let me know in the Feedback thread or in the Discord if you have any feedback or discover any bugs!
